# Synthetic provenance manual

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE ONLY. Demonstration of local retrieval and source references; not an engineering authority.

## Section A Thickness and pressure records

Inspection records may contain multiple thickness readings per asset tag. Keep each reading distinct. Keep pressure units explicit. Convert inches to millimetres only with an explicit recorded unit. Preserve source page references alongside normalized values.

## Section B Retained history

Retain the inspection report, extracted measurements, routing trace, calculation execution result, retrieved source sections and draft document under the same job identifier. Retain unsuccessful attempts as audit events.
